$comment: The monitoring tab of a line: every monitor declared once, placed by bin/monitors.sh at its slot (row.col of the 3x3). ${line}, ${ws}, ${repo} and any ${ENV_NAME} are substituted when the pane is started. interval 0: the command runs for as long as the pane does; interval N: it is re-run every N seconds. down runs on monitors-down, before the tab closes.
